claims.statement: Regulation (EU) 2024/573 requires operators of covered equipment to keep specified gas and service records and requires certified persons for defined leak-check and service activities.

contrary_evidence: Hermetically sealed and low-charge equipment can be exempt, and natural-refrigerant adoption may shrink the target F-gas asset base.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: the installed-asset graph and credential history reduce fraud and service handoff friction across participating contractors
fingerprint.customer: certified commercial heat-pump and refrigeration service contractors plus multi-site equipment owners
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: refrigerant wholesalers, certification trainers, and equipment distributors embed the service rail
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: mobile evidence capture, certificate verification, refrigerant ledger, reminders, and regulator-ready export
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the contractor pays when a credentialed service record is signed; the owner can pay for portfolio custody
fingerprint.problem_trigger: a regulated asset is installed, leak-checked, repaired, recharged, or decommissioned

founder_fit: Good renewable-family channel and workflow-automation fit; the product is asynchronous and can be piloted without owning refrigerant or performing regulated work.
risks: A digital log cannot substitute for legally required certification.
Contractors may resist transparent credential and refrigerant tracking.

structure.control_point: credential-verified service record signed at commissioning, leak check, recharge, repair, or decommissioning
structure.critical_dependency: participation by certified contractors and acceptance of digital records by asset owners and inspectors

thesis: Give certified heat-pump and refrigeration contractors a durable asset log that verifies technician credentials, refrigerant movements, leak checks, and post-repair checks at the service event. Focus only on equipment actually subject to record-keeping, not exempt small systems. All commercial numbers, including capital_required_pln, are unvalidated hypotheses.
title: F-gas Service Evidence Rail for Commercial Heat Pumps
uncertainties: Whether inspectors will prefer this export format is unvalidated.
Addressable service-event volume by equipment class is unknown.
